account.confirmedBody: Open Coach Poulpy on the phone you signed up with: it signs you in and sends your training.
account.confirmedPoulpy: Lifting your training into the cloud. Eight tentacles, no waiting.
account.confirmExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after 24 hours. Sign up again in the app with the same address and we’ll send a new one.
account.resetExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after an hour. In the app, tap “Forgot your password?” to get a new one.
account.resetIntro: Every phone signed in to this account will be signed out.
account.savedBody: Every phone was signed out. Open Coach Poulpy and sign in with your new password.
account.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.

admin.signInIntro: The admin is for the people who look after Coach Poulpy.
admin.errorSignIn: Wrong email or password, or this account isn’t an admin’s.
admin.errorTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
admin.auditIntro: Everything an admin changed, newest first. Only admins see this.
admin.auditEmpty: Nothing yet. Admin changes show up here.
admin.auditError: The audit log can’t be loaded. Try again.
